optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: Only statements traceable to the cited sources are presented as supported; everything else is recorded as unsupported, a gap or a follow-up question.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Platform Engineer, Build and CI role.

evidence.text: Platform engineer at Quillstack from September 2020 to June 2024, maintaining the CI runners and the remote build cache for about 140 repositories, including the Linux and macOS runner pools.
evidence.notes: Directly states maintenance of CI runners and caches for 140 repositories.

evidence.text: The former director of engineering confirmed in writing that the candidate was the designated technical lead for the build-system migration from April 2022 to January 2023 and that the cutover schedule was the candidate's responsibility.
evidence.notes: Explicit confirmation of technical lead role.

evidence.text: Wrote the onboarding runbook for the new build setup and covered the platform help channel on a weekly rota, answering build questions from product engineers.
evidence.notes: Shows runbook creation and support of product engineers.

evidence.text: Managed the CI fleet through Terraform modules; every change went through a pull request reviewed by a second platform engineer.
evidence.notes: Demonstrates Terraform IaC management with peer review.

evidence.text: Work sample: a redacted copy of the Bazel migration design document, including its decision table (eight decisions, each initialled by the candidate as decider) and the per-repository cutover checklist.
evidence.notes: Provides evidence of designing and running a formal training/course.

Ensure that the training course covered all required tooling aspects and was delivered to a representative group of product engineers.

limitations: The evidence does not detail the specific Terraform modules used or the exact scale of the production environment.
